payday.note: Each day indexed to its own month's mean, so this is a within-month pattern, not seasonality. Pay window = last 3 + first 3 days of the month (monthly salaries); mid-month covers fortnightly pay.

weather.note: Wet-day effect = throughput on above-median-rainfall days vs the rest; sunny-day effect uses above-median sunshine hours. Correlations are throughput vs rainfall, max temperature and sun.

events.note: Effect is event days vs nearby non-event days (season-matched, so it is not just summer vs winter). Long championship windows are listed as seasons, not match-day effects: those need specific fixture dates from the GAA/Ticketmaster API. Upcoming impact applies the learned effect to the baseline. Set RFS_TM_KEY for live concerts and games.
